description: This file defines functions and types related to tensor expression fusion within the Torch JIT compiler, including mechanisms to fuse tensor operations, enable/disable dynamic shape fusion, remove profile nodes, insert type guards, and work with custom operators. It provides an interface for tensor expression fusion and shape/type management in Torch JIT.

methods.name: FuseTensorExprs
methods.description: Runs TensorExpressions-based fusion on the provided graph, with options for group size, adding composed operations, and dynamic shape fusion.

methods.name: setTensorExprFuserEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables the tensor expression fuser.

methods.name: tensorExprFuserEnabled
methods.description: Checks if the tensor expression fuser is enabled.

methods.name: setTensorExprDynamicShapeFusionEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables dynamic shape fusion in tensor expressions.

methods.name: tensorExprDynamicShapeFusionEnabled
methods.description: Checks if dynamic shape fusion is enabled.

methods.name: setTexprReductionsEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables tensor expression reductions.

methods.name: texprReductionsEnabled
methods.description: Checks if tensor expression reductions are enabled.

methods.name: RemoveProfileNodesAndSpecializeTypes
methods.description: Removes profile nodes and specializes types in the given graph.

methods.name: hasTensorTypeSpecialization
methods.description: Checks if a tensor value has a type specialization.

methods.name: RemoveTensorTypeSpecializations
methods.description: Removes tensor type specializations from the graph.

methods.name: removeTensorTypeSpecializations
methods.description: Removes tensor type specializations from a block.

methods.name: insertTypeGuard
methods.description: Inserts a type guard pattern around a node to verify tensor input types.

methods.name: usedOnlyInSize
methods.description: Checks if the value is used only for size queries.

methods.name: broadcastSizes
methods.description: Computes broadcasted sizes from a list of size values.

methods.name: getCustomOperatorSet
methods.description: Returns the modifiable custom operator set object used for custom operator management.
